visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with dark hair and red lipstick, wearing a red sweater and a white-brown patterned cardigan, smiles cheerfully at the camera while holding several plain red envelopes in her right hand. The setting is a bright, airy indoor living room featuring white curtains and a decorative white tree adorned with warm fairy lights. (2) Multiple hands reach into the center of the frame from different directions to scramble and grab the red envelopes from a pile. A young child wearing a patterned bib is partially visible as the group interacts playfully. The floor is light wood, and the lighting is bright. (3) An older man wearing a black leather jacket over a polo shirt and a black baseball cap opens a red envelope and finds it empty. He looks disappointed and turns the envelope upside down to show its contents. He sits on a beige sofa in the same living room. (4) An older woman with short hair and a purple scarf holds a red envelope and speaks with a frustrated and skeptical facial expression. She gestures with her hands as she looks towards the man next to her. The lighting remains warm and domestic. (5) A young boy wearing a black Minecraft-themed hoodie pulls a thick stack of blue 1000 TWD banknotes out of his red envelope. His face is wide with shock and extreme joy, staring at the money as it is revealed in a slow-motion-style shot. (6) A young girl with pigtails looks directly into the camera with a furious and jealous expression, holding a single envelope. Her mouth is slightly agape in a pout. The background is a brightly lit home environment with white festive decorations. (7) The narrator woman returns to the screen, holding several envelopes and looking flustered. She talks to the camera, pointing at the identical appearances of the envelopes. Behind her, family members and the decorative tree are visible in the background. (8) A smartphone screen displays a recording of the ibon app, showing a user selecting family photos to place onto festive red envelope templates. The interface is clean, bright, and easy to read. (9) A person’s hand interacts with a grey 7-Eleven ibon kiosk inside a retail store. The store shelves are visible in the background under bright fluorescent lighting. (10) The kiosk prints out a sheet of paper with vibrant red envelope designs featuring the custom photos. A hand retrieves the paper from the machine. (11) The entire family, including the children, the older couple, and the woman, gather together holding their new personalized red envelopes with their photos on them. They wave at the camera and cheer with broad smiles. (12) The woman and the young girl stand outside a 7-Eleven store near the entrance. They wave happily at the camera in natural daylight to close the video.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote 7-Eleven's ibon customized red envelope service by presenting a humorous and relatable family scenario where generic red envelopes lead to confusion and disappointment, positioning the personalized photo envelopes as the perfect solution for Lunar New Year.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Clear mention of the brand name 7-Eleven and ibon, a detailed tutorial on how to use the specific customized red envelope printing service, and a strong call to action.
